description: Capabilities for the always-on-top notification overlay window (label: notif-overlay). Minimal: drag it around, close it, focus it, and listen for harbor-notification events from the main window. No store, no sql, no socket — the overlay holds no persistent state and receives each notification as a global Tauri event. It emits harbor-navigate (main window focuses + routes to chat) and harbor-notif-dismiss (main window drops the card from the queue slot rotation).
